meta.name: India State of Forest Report 2023: district-wise forest cover
meta.license: Government of India open data; cite FSI
meta.limitations: Districts of the 2023 report that are not in data/ref/districts2020.csv (new districts) are not joined. See data/meta/forest_district.md. Row names that the PDF wraps over several lines are rebuilt by a script heuristic and may fail (counted as unmatched).
meta.method: pdftotext -layout of Volume 2; rows with 8 numbers (calculated area, VDF, MDF, OF, total, %, change, scrub); names joined from wrapped lines; matched to district2020 by normalised name inside the state (exact, then difflib ratio >= 0.88).

calc_area_km2.name: Calculated area by Survey of India

forest_cover_pct.name: Forest cover share of calculated area

change_vs_2021_km2.name: Change in forest cover vs ISFR 2021 (raster based)

source_district.name: District name in source
source_district.description: Only when it differs from the district2020 name.
